description.en: A folder that opens in a new File Explorer window becomes a tab of the window already open. Needs Windows 11 22H2 or newer
description.zh: 新开的文件夹窗口并到已经开着的资源管理器里，成为一个标签页。需要 Windows 11 22H2 或更新

notes.zh: 读不到资源管理器窗口时，在日志里记下加载进本插件的外来 DLL（安全软件、界面修改工具等），便于找出原因（#331）。需要 Win顺 0.37.0。权限不变。
notes.en: When File Explorer's windows cannot be read, the DLLs from elsewhere loaded into the plugin (security software, shell tweakers) are logged, to find the cause (#331). Needs WinShun 0.37.0. Permissions unchanged.
